execution_engine.not_matlab_caveat: MATLAB execution in this project is documented BOOTSTRAP-ONLY (scripts/matlab/README.md), requiring a human-driven MATLAB Online session; that pathway was not used here. This is NOT because Karr/WholeCell source is unavailable: the full upstream WholeCell source tree (including the complete Simulation classdef object graph and RandStream.m) IS present locally at E:\opencell-mirrors\WholeCell (a mirror/junction outside this git worktree). The isolated per-process harness approach below was a deliberate tractability choice, not a source-availability workaround: replaying the original extract_per_process_traces_v2.m pattern requires instantiating and fitting a full Simulation object via the KnowledgeBase construction pipeline, which is a heavyweight, long-running MATLAB-only process not reproducible from this sandboxed session in Octave. Both target code paths, however, are isolable without that full object graph (see scripts/octave_h12_perturbation/README.md), so this harness runs the VERBATIM vendored Karr .m logic (function bodies transcribed unmodified from data/karr_vendored_source/*.m) with only the WholeCell RandStream/base-Process classdef scaffolding replaced by minimal harness stubs, documented per-scenario below. The real edu.stanford.covert.util.RandStream.m source (E:\opencell-mirrors\WholeCell\src\+edu\+stanford\+covert\+util\RandStream.m, method stochasticRound, line 236) was read and confirmed to match this harness's stochasticRoundStub.m formula exactly (roundUp = rand < mod(value,1); ceil if roundUp else floor); mnrnd is MATLAB's Statistics Toolbox builtin (not custom WholeCell code), and mnrndStub.m reimplements its documented multinomial-sampling semantics. Where a scenario's RNG-dependent code path IS exercised (MacromolecularComplexation network>=2), the Octave drivers seed via the legacy `rand('seed', k)` API (scripts/octave_h12_perturbation/run_macromol_network2.m) -- this is Octave/MATLAB's backward-compatible legacy seeding syntax, not an assertion that Octave's underlying generator algorithm matches MATLAB's RandStream implementation; no bit-identical RNG claim is made, so evidence from that scenario is DISTRIBUTIONAL/STRUCTURAL (invariant-checked across 50 independent seeds), never claimed as bit-exact H12 evidence. Where a scenario's perturbed values are constructed so that no fractional/RNG-consuming code path is ever reached (ProteinProcessingII Scenario A), the harness stub's specific RNG behavior is provably irrelevant to the outcome, so exact-match H12 evidence IS claimed for that one constructed regime only (see caveats in the generated artifacts).

shared_derivation_notes.margin_policy: Every scarce guard is failed with a margin (not at the exact integer boundary) to avoid a state whose PASS/FAIL regime could flip due to floating-point or stochasticRound boundary sensitivity; every passing guard is passed with a margin for the same reason. The one deliberately near-fair-coin fractional part per state (see each state's `hand_traced_mechanics`) is the sole exception, chosen BECAUSE it is near 0.5, specifically to make cross-seed stochasticRound variation robustly observable in only 50 draws -- this is choosing a value to make the STOCHASTIC MECHANISM legible, not to fit a predicted outcome (no outcome is predicted at the per-species point level; see evidence_contract).

exact_zero_tolerance_claims: mass_conservation: sum(unprocessedMonomers_after) + sum(processedMonomers_after) + sum(passthroughMonomers_after) == sum(unprocessedMonomers_before) for every seed, exactly.
non_negativity: every post-state species count and every pool count >= 0, for every seed, exactly.

per_species_cap: processed_count(species) <= unprocessedMonomers_before(species), for every seed and species, exactly (stochasticRound/mnrnd can only reallocate/round DOWN from raw demand at the species actually processed, never invent monomer mass).

pool_cap_peptidase: sum(final_transformations(peptidaseIndexs)) <= substrates_water_before, for every seed, exactly -- proved unconditionally in the pre-registration's derivation appendix (see H12 turn-1 intent, part C) from the min(rounded_transformations, mnrnd_draw) clamping structure and mnrnd's exact-sum-to-n multinomial identity; holds regardless of which stochastic path (mnrnd firing or not) is realized.

pool_cap_transferase: sum(final_transformations(transferaseIndexs)) <= substrates_PG160_before, for every seed, exactly -- same proof structure as pool_cap_peptidase, applied to the PG160/transferase side.
distributional_only_claims: species_allocation: the exact per-species processed count for any species subject to stochasticRound (non-integer scaled demand) or mnrnd (pool below aggregate demand) is NOT claimed as an exact point prediction -- only that it lies in the algebraic bound above, and that it is observed to VARY across the pre-registered independent seeds for at least one species in every state whose `hand_traced_mechanics` names a firing stochastic mechanism (this is the cross-seed-variation requirement: mnrnd/stochasticRound must not degenerate into a no-op across the seed schedule, which would silently launder a deterministic scenario as stochastic evidence).
evidence_contract.anti_laundering_boundary: Predictions (predict_ppii_scarcity_bounds) are computed from `states_before`-only pre-registered inputs and frozen (written to the input CSV/JSON consumed by the Octave driver) before any Octave process is invoked; the ingest/comparison phase (ingest_ppii_scenario_b) reads ONLY the Octave-produced `states_after` CSVs plus the frozen prediction, never the OC SUT, never a runner, never any oracle-after value from the natural trace. This mirrors the existing PREDICT_PHASE_FUNCTIONS/COMPARE_PHASE_FUNCTIONS AST-import-guard split already enforced for Scenario A and MacromolecularComplexation network2 by tests/scripts/test_h12_perturbation.py.

water_scarce.hand_traced_mechanics: block1 skipped (no lipoprotein unprocessed monomers); block2: peptidaseLimit=638 (unreduced) >= demand(50), so stochasticRound scaling is a no-op (scale=1, all integer inputs); sum(transformations)=50 > water(30), so mnrnd(30, [20,15,10,5]/50) FIRES -- this state exercises mnrnd only, not stochasticRound, and is the designated canary state.

pg160_scarce.hand_traced_mechanics: block1 fires (lipoprotein unprocessed monomers present): peptidase-side scale=min(1,638/5)=1 (no-op); transferase-side scale=min(1,6.138/5)=1 (no-op) -- transformations remain the exact integers [3,1,1] through both scaling steps, so stochasticRound is a no-op; sum(transferase-side)=5 > PG160(3), so mnrnd(3, [3,1,1]/5) FIRES -- this state exercises mnrnd only (transferase/PG160 side), the structural mirror of water_scarce on the transferase side.
